method: One low-rate read-only GET per documented public example board, after reviewing current official documentation; raw responses retained only in an uncommitted temporary directory.

sources.documentation_finding: Published Job Board GET data is public and does not require authentication; content=true includes the description.
sources.board_identifier_source: Greenhouse's public company careers page links to job-boards.greenhouse.io/greenhouse.
sources.robots_finding: User-agent * disallows /embed/ only; the tested API path is not disallowed.

sources.documentation_finding: The v0 Postings API is for publicly viewable published jobs; the official documentation names jobs.lever.co/leverdemo as its example board and states published jobs may be scraped by third parties.
sources.board_identifier_source: Official Lever Postings API documentation example.
sources.optional_field_handling: Missing location and description remain empty and are excluded by deterministic completeness/geography screening; no value is invented.
sources.robots_finding: User-agent * allows / and declares Crawl-delay: 1; the probe exceeded that delay between same-domain requests.

sources.documentation_finding: The public Job Postings API returns currently published postings; the official guide documents the read-only GET, includeCompensation, and Ashby as the example board name.
sources.robots_finding: The API-domain robots file itself returned 401. The public board robots file disallows /meeting/, /b/, and /api/; the official, separately hosted posting-api GET is expressly documented and returned 200. This is recorded as a warning and is not generalized to undisclosed endpoints.

limitations: This validates contracts and access behavior only. It does not establish employer eligibility, active bioinformatics openings, redistribution permission for full text, or a production sample. Contracts must be revalidated at each monthly run.
